description: This Java source file defines the AdHocData class, a data transfer object (DTO) that encapsulates information related to ad-hoc queries within the Fineract system. It includes metadata such as query details, created/updated timestamps, user info, and report frequency options.

classes.name: AdHocData
classes.description: Immutable DTO representing ad-hoc query information, including metadata and report frequency options.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template instance of AdHocData with report run frequency options populated from the ReportRunFrequency enum.
